title: Known-issues ledger entry
description: A durable record of a deliberately degraded, disabled, or accepted-risk capability and the containment currently in force. Health classes describe now; this ledger is what makes a contained degradation auditable over months.

issue_id.description: Stable handle, so the same defect is discussed as one thing across months.

capability_id.description: The capability row this degrades, joining the ledger to the capability status layer.

containment.description: The compensating instruction in force, rendered into the generated operator view so a disabled lane cannot be silently rediscovered as available.

evidence.description: Where the proof of the classification lives.

freshness_class.description: How long the classification may be trusted before re-verification. An expired entry is a prompt to re-verify, not a fact.

reenable_criteria.description: What must be true to switch the capability back on. Re-enable is a gate against written criteria, not a judgement call by whoever finds the entry next.

successor_capability_id.description: Which capability took over this one's purpose, when the lane was retired rather than repaired.

closure.description: Set only when the issue is closed by restoration and verification.
